source_field_semantics.yes: The client inventory classifies the row as active-outdated and requiring remediation.
source_field_semantics.no: The client inventory does not classify the row as active-outdated; firmware observed on these rows is client-accepted baseline evidence.
source_field_semantics.authority_ceiling: Client estate classification evidence only. It does not prove vendor-global latest firmware, package availability, management entitlement, or update authorization.

observed_client_accepted_candidates.basis: Observed in the client source where Active Outdated is No.
observed_client_accepted_candidates.ambiguity: This numerically older version is still accepted by the client classification. The reason is unresolved and must remain explicit.

observed_client_accepted_candidates.basis: Observed in the client source where Active Outdated is No.

selection.ordering: compare every dot-separated numeric component as an integer tuple
selection.rationale: Use the highest observed client-accepted candidate as the default planning target while authoritative estate-specific package mapping remains unresolved.
supersession_requires: stronger H&H estate-specific management-plane or owner evidence
a client source revision that changes the accepted candidate set

ambiguities.question: Why does the client source accept a numerically older firmware version, and is that classification current?
ambiguities.handling: Do not discard the row, relabel it as outdated, or treat it as the rollout target solely to remove the inconsistency. Carry the ambiguity into management-plane clarification.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Public PAX/AxiaMed documentation identifies Control Center as a cloud payment-device management surface for PAX Android devices. Current Bank of America Healthcare Omni-Channel documentation explicitly lists Control Center terminal management and Automatic terminal updating, plus IngEstate Remote terminal communication and a Terminal software repository. Operator-managed H&H evidence also records the AxiaMed gateway as an existing-account login surface.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: The platform capability is no longer an evidence gap. Required next state is authorized read access to Payment Fusion Control Center / Healthcare Omni-Channel / IngEstate that exposes the representative terminal, software or firmware state, and automatic-update policy or assignment controls. Until such credentials are present in the execution environment, preserve CREDENTIAL_GATE for this exact surface; do not replace it with a generic owner-identification request.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: The H&H reader Connectivity Test exposes PAX Store Push Service Primary on TCP 443, while PAX documents over-the-air firmware updates. Current PAXSTORE role documentation defines Firmware List as firmware/update notice/details by terminal and Terminal Management as terminal status/information, with Readonly or Full privilege levels. Operator-managed evidence records that a public PAXSTORE account reaches Marketplace/App Store but does not expose fleet Terminal Management.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: For read-only discovery, the minimum requested estate role is Readonly Firmware List + Terminal Management for the representative H&H terminal. Full/write/push privileges are not required for discovery and remain outside this lane. Preserve CREDENTIAL_GATE until that read role exists; do not add, reassign, activate, or push to an H&H terminal merely to test account scope.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Other providers expose terminal-initiated TMS/NTMS update flows on PAX A80, but the fully captured unlocked H&H AxiaMed admin surface exposes network, connectivity, diagnostic, environment, and reset controls with no NTMS, TMS, Update, or Firmware control. Diagnostic exploration likewise found no local firmware path.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Treat the currently exposed H&H local AxiaMed/admin surface as NOT_APPLICABLE for firmware update. Do not restage local menu exploration. Reopen this lane only if a materially new application/control surface or estate-specific documentation explicitly exposes an NTMS/TMS/Update/Firmware action.

candidate_order.evidence_basis: Current Bank of America Healthcare Omni-Channel documentation explicitly lists Control Center Automatic terminal updating and IngEstate Remote terminal communication plus a Terminal software repository. Current PAXSTORE material also documents remote firmware updates and policy-based distribution. Automatic update is therefore a proven platform capability on leading candidate stacks, but the H&H representative terminal's enrollment, update policy, package assignment, and target mapping remain unproved.
candidate_order.next_discriminator: Resolve automatic update H&H applicability through authorized read access to Payment Fusion Control Center / IngEstate or PAXSTORE estate views: inspect the representative terminal's update-policy, job, and package state without initiating or changing a task. Until that read access exists, preserve CREDENTIAL_GATE; do not infer H&H applicability from platform capability alone.

proven_path_acceptance.purpose: Define the exact acceptance record that may promote one named mechanism from CREDENTIAL_GATE to PROVEN_PATH after authorized read-only estate observation.
proven_path_acceptance.completion_gate: One eligible mechanism proposes PROVEN_PATH only when ACCESS_STATE is PROVEN_ACCESS, the representative terminal is bound, current firmware is observed, all seven estate-authority packet fields are answered, no discovery mutation occurred, and the package mapping is either YES with a release id or NO/NONE_OBSERVED recorded as an explicit conflict against the planning candidate.
proven_path_acceptance.proof_ceiling: A PROVEN_PATH acceptance record proves the authoritative estate binding and package/update contract for planning. It does not authorize a firmware push, one-reader pilot, or fleet rollout.

readonly_estate_checklist.purpose: Ordered read-only estate observation checklist for Payment Fusion/Healthcare Omni-Channel/IngEstate or PAXSTORE. No push, assign, activate, approve, reset, enrollment, reassignment, or package change is permitted.

minimum_role_by_surface.payment-fusion-control-center: authorized read access exposing representative terminal, firmware/software state, and automatic-update policy or assignment controls
minimum_role_by_surface.provider-auto-update: authorized read access to Control Center/IngEstate or PAXSTORE estate views for update-policy, job, and package state

items.observation: Confirm an already-authorized read-only session exists on one eligible estate surface. Do not create accounts or request owner identification.
Confirm the session role meets the surface minimum read role. Full/write/push is not required for discovery.
Locate the representative H&H A80 terminal record without adding, activating, or reassigning terminals.
Bind a non-secret READER_IDENTITY_REF to the observed terminal record. Live serial/IP/MAC stay external.
Record the authoritative current firmware/package shown for that terminal.
Inspect automatic-update policy/job/package state without initiating, altering, approving, or cancelling a task.
Resolve whether 2.0.15.260522 is exposed. Record YES with release id, NO/NONE_OBSERVED as conflict, or UNKNOWN with reason.
Record the supported assignment/update method using the surface's own verb. Observe the affordance; do not invoke it.
Record required reboot/reconnect/wait behavior from the same authority.
Record rollback, cancel, or exception handling if the job fails or must be reversed.
Record the post-update acceptance criterion stated by that authority.
Index a non-secret AUTHORITY_PACKET_ID and sanitized classifications only. Credentials, live terminal identifiers, and restricted screenshots stay external.

required_markers: machine policy is the source of truth

proof_ceiling: Repository policy proves how client inventory evidence is interpreted, how the fleet-level default planning candidate is selected, and the exact PROVEN_PATH acceptance plus read-only estate checklist seams. It does not prove a site-authorized execution target, vendor-global latest firmware, package entitlement, supported assignment, a successful update, or production rollout acceptance.

resolution_evidence: authoritative H&H site/hospital owner or management-plane evidence
an explicit registered site override when the site operates independently or differs from the organization baseline
